T1.implementation_approach: Design a responsive UI using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript frameworks. Use components for problem listing, filtering, and searching.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful APIs for problem management (create, read, update, delete). Implement authentication and authorization.

T3.implementation_approach: Design normalized tables for storing problem details, tags, difficulty levels, and metadata.
T3.notes: Optimize for query performance and data integrity.

T4.implementation_approach: Create a UI for code submission using forms and syntax highlighting. Include error handling and submission status.
T4.notes: Ensure real-time feedback and user-friendly design.

T5.implementation_approach: Implement a sandboxed code execution environment. Validate inputs, execute code, and compare outputs with expected results.
T5.notes: Ensure security and prevent malicious code execution.

T6.implementation_approach: Design a UI for user profiles with sections for personal details, achievements, and activity history.
T6.notes: Focus on personalization and ease of use.

T7.implementation_approach: Develop APIs for managing user profiles, including updating details and fetching activity logs.
T7.notes: Ensure secure access to user data.

T8.implementation_approach: Design a leaderboard UI with sorting and filtering options. Display rankings based on user performance.
T8.notes: Ensure real-time updates and visual appeal.

T9.implementation_approach: Develop APIs for fetching leaderboard data and updating rankings based on user submissions.

T10.implementation_approach: Design a UI for hints and tutorials with sections for text, images, and videos. Include search and categorization features.

T11.implementation_approach: Develop APIs for managing hints and tutorials, including adding, updating, and retrieving content.

T12.implementation_approach: Write unit and integration tests for problem library functionality. Use mock data and test edge cases.

T13.implementation_approach: Test code submission and evaluation system using various test cases, including edge cases and invalid inputs.

T14.implementation_approach: Test user profile functionality, including data updates and activity logs. Validate security measures.
T14.notes: Ensure data consistency and secure access.

T15.implementation_approach: Test leaderboard functionality, including sorting, filtering, and real-time updates.

T16.implementation_approach: Test hints and tutorials functionality, including content retrieval and search features.

T17.implementation_approach: Deploy the platform using containerization and cloud services. Set up CI/CD pipelines for automated deployment.

from flask_sqlalchemy import SQLAlchemy

# Initialize SQLAlchemy instance
db = SQLAlchemy()

from app.database import db

class Problem(db.Model):
    __tablename__ = 'problems'

    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    title = db.Column(db.String(255), nullable=False)
    description = db.Column(db.Text, nullable=False)
    difficulty = db.Column(db.String(50), nullable=False)
    created_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, default=db.func.current_timestamp(), nullable=False)
    updated_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, default=db.func.current_timestamp(), onupdate=db.func.current_timestamp(), nullable=False)

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"<Problem {self.id} - {self.title}>"

from app.database import db


class User(db.Model):
    __tablename__ = 'users'

    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    username = db.Column(db.String(80), nullable=False, unique=True)
    email = db.Column(db.String(120), nullable=False, unique=True)
    password_hash = db.Column(db.String(128), nullable=False)
    created_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, nullable=False, server_default=db.func.now())

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"<User {self.username}>"

from app.database import db

class Solution(db.Model):
    __tablename__ = 'solutions'

    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    user_id = db.Column(db.Integer, db.ForeignKey('users.id'), nullable=False)
    problem_id = db.Column(db.Integer, db.ForeignKey('problems.id'), nullable=False)
    code = db.Column(db.Text, nullable=False)
    language = db.Column(db.String(50), nullable=False)
    status = db.Column(db.String(50), nullable=False)  # e.g., 'Accepted', 'Wrong Answer', etc.
    created_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, nullable=False, default=db.func.now())
    updated_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, nullable=False, default=db.func.now(), onupdate=db.func.now())

    user = db.relationship('User', backref=db.backref('solutions', lazy=True))
    problem = db.relationship('Problem', backref=db.backref('solutions', lazy=True))

# app/routes.py
# Layer: assembly

from app.controllers.problem_controller import problem_controller
from app.controllers.user_controller import user_controller
from app.controllers.solution_controller import solution_controller

def register_blueprints(app):
    """
    Register all blueprints to the Flask application instance.
    
    Args:
        app (Flask): The Flask application instance.
    """
    app.register_blueprint(problem_blueprint)
    app.register_blueprint(user_blueprint)
    app.register_blueprint(solution_blueprint)

from flask import Flask
from app.database import db
from app.routes import register_blueprints

def create_app():
    app = Flask(__name__)
    
    # Configure the app (add configuration settings if needed)
    app.config['SQLALCHEMY_TRACK_MODIFICATIONS'] = False

    # Initialize database
    db.init_app(app)

    # Register blueprints
    register_blueprints(app)
    
    return app

from app import create_app

# Entry point for the application
if __name__ == "__main__":
    app = create_app()
    app.run(debug=True)

# ACM Problem-Solving Platform

A website designed to help users solve ACM-style competitive programming problems.

## Features

- Problem Library: A comprehensive library of ACM-style problems categorized by difficulty and topic.
- Code Submission and Evaluation: Allows users to submit code solutions and receive instant feedback on correctness and performance.
- User Profiles: Enables users to create profiles to track their progress, solved problems, and rankings.
- Leaderboard: Displays rankings of users based on their problem-solving performance.
- Hints and Tutorials: Provides hints and tutorials for selected problems to help users improve their skills.

## Setup

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
python app.py
```

## Usage

Open http://localhost:5000 in your browser.
